--pools.label: Pools
--pools.description: Thread count per NUMA pool, comma separated; - means no threads and + means one per core.

--preset.label: Preset
--preset.description: Speed preset; slower presets improve compression at the cost of encoding time.

--profile.label: Profile
--profile.description: Enforce an encode profile: main, main10, mainstillpicture

--psy-rd.label: PSY Rd
--psy-rd.description: Strength of psycho-visual rate-distortion optimization, 0 to disable. Default 2.0

--psy-rdoq.label: PSY Rdoq
--psy-rdoq.description: Strength of psycho-visual optimization in RDO quantization, 0 to disable. Default 0.0

--qcomp.label: Qcomp
--qcomp.description: Weight given to predicted complexity. Default 0.60

--qg-size.label: Qg Size
--qg-size.description: Specifies the size of the quantization group (64, 32, 16, 8). Default 32

--qp.label: QP
--qp.description: QP for P slices in CQP mode (implied). --ipratio and --pbration determine other slice QPs

--qp-adaptation-range.label: QP Adaptation Range
--qp-adaptation-range.description: Delta QP range by QP adaptation based on a psycho-visual model (1.0 to 6.0). Default 1.00

--qpfile.label: Qpfile

--qpmax.label: Qpmax
--qpmax.description: sets a hard upper limit on QP allowed to ratecontrol. Default 69

--qpmin.label: Qpmin
--qpmin.description: sets a hard lower limit on QP allowed to ratecontrol. Default 0

--qpstep.label: Qpstep
--qpstep.description: The maximum single adjustment in QP allowed to rate control. Default 4

--radl.label: Radl
--radl.description: Number of RADL pictures allowed in front of IDR. Default 0

--range.label: Range
--range.description: Specify black level and range of luma and chroma signals as full or limited Default limited

--rc-lookahead.label: RC Lookahead

--rd-refine.label: Rd Refine
--rd-refine.description: Enable QP-based RD refinement for rd levels 5 and 6. Default disabled

--rdpenalty.label: Rdpenalty

--rect.label: Rect
--rect.description: Enable rectangular motion partitions Nx2N and 2NxN. Default disabled

--ref.label: Ref
--ref.description: max number of L0 references to be allowed (1 .. 16) Default 3

--refine-analysis-type.label: Refine Analysis Type
--refine-analysis-type.description: Reuse analysis information received through API call. Supported options are AVC and HEVC. Default disabled - 0

--refine-inter.label: Refine Inter
--refine-inter.description: Enable inter refinement for encode that uses analysis-load.

--refine-intra.label: Refine Intra
--refine-intra.description: Enable intra-refinement for encode that uses analysis-load.

--refine-mv.label: Refine MV
--refine-mv.description: Enable mv refinement for load mode. Default 1

--repeat-headers.label: Repeat Headers
--repeat-headers.description: Emit SPS and PPS headers at each keyframe. Default disabled

--rskip.label: Rskip
--rskip.description: Enable recursion skip for an early exit from CTU analysis during inter-prediction.

--rskip-edge-threshold.label: Rskip Edge Threshold
--rskip-edge-threshold.description: Threshold in terms of percentage (an integer of range [0,100]) for minimum edge density in CU's used to prune the recursion depth. Applicable only to rskip mode 2. Value is preset dependent. Default: 5

--sao.label: SAO
--sao.description: Enable Sample Adaptive Offset. Default enabled

--sao-non-deblock.label: SAO Non Deblock
--sao-non-deblock.description: Use non-deblocked pixels, else right/bottom boundary areas skipped. Default disabled

--sar.label: Sar
--sar.description: Sample Aspect Ratio, the ratio of width to height of an individual pixel. Choose from 0=undef, 1=1:1("square"), 2=12:11, 3=10:11, 4=16:11, 5=40:33, 6=24:11, 7=20:11, 8=32:11, 9=80:33, 10=18:11, 11=15:11, 12=64:33, 13=160:99, 14=4:3, 15=3:2, 16=2:1 or custom ratio of <int:int>. Default 0

--sbrc.label: Sbrc
--sbrc.description: Enables the segment based rate control. Default disabled

--scale-factor.label: Scale Factor
--scale-factor.description: Specify the factor by which the input video is scaled down for analysis save mode. Default 0

--scaling-list.label: Scaling List
--scaling-list.description: Specify a file containing HM style quant scaling lists or 'default' or 'off'. Default: off

--scenecut.label: Scenecut
--scenecut.description: How aggressively to insert extra I-frames. Default 40

--scenecut-aware-qp.label: Scenecut Aware QP
--scenecut-aware-qp.description: Enable increasing QP for frames inside the scenecut window around scenecut. Default disabled 0 - Disabled 1 - Forward masking 2 - Backward masking 3 - Bidirectional masking

--scenecut-qp-config.label: Scenecut QP Config
--scenecut-qp-config.description: File containing scenecut-aware-qp mode, window duration and offsets settings required for the masking. Works only with --pass 2

--signhide.label: Signhide
--signhide.description: Hide sign bit of one coeff per TU (rdo). Default enabled

--slow-firstpass.label: Slow Firstpass
--slow-firstpass.description: Enable a slow first pass in a multipass rate control mode. Default enabled

--splitrd-skip.label: Splitrd Skip
--splitrd-skip.description: Enable skipping split RD analysis when sum of split CU rdCost larger than one split CU rdCost for Intra CU. Default disabled

--ssim-rd.label: SSIM Rd
--ssim-rd.description: Enable ssim rate-distortion optimization, 0 to disable. Default disabled

--stats.label: Stats
--stats.description: Filename for stats file in multipass pass rate control. Default x265_2pass.log

--strict-cbr.label: Strict CBR
--strict-cbr.description: Enable stricter conditions and tolerance for bitrate deviations in CBR mode. Default disabled

--strong-intra-smoothing.label: Strong Intra Smoothing
--strong-intra-smoothing.description: Enable strong intra smoothing for 32x32 blocks. Default enabled

--subme.label: Subme
--subme.description: Amount of subpel refinement to perform (0:least .. 7:most). Default 2

--temporal-layers.label: Temporal Layers
--temporal-layers.description: Enable a temporal sublayer for unreferenced B frames. Default disabled

--temporal-mvp.label: Temporal Mvp
--temporal-mvp.description: Enable temporal MV predictors. Default enabled

--transfer.label: Transfer
--transfer.description: Specify transfer characteristics from bt709, unknown, reserved, bt470m, bt470bg, smpte170m, smpte240m, linear, log100, log316, iec61966-2-4, bt1361e, iec61966-2-1, bt2020-10, bt2020-12, smpte2084, smpte428, arib-std-b67. Default unknown

--tskip.label: Tskip
--tskip.description: Enable intra 4x4 transform skipping. Default disabled

--tskip-fast.label: Tskip Fast
--tskip-fast.description: Enable fast intra transform skipping. Default disabled

--tu-inter-depth.label: TU Inter Depth
--tu-inter-depth.description: Max TU recursive depth for inter CUs. Default 1

--tu-intra-depth.label: TU Intra Depth
--tu-intra-depth.description: Max TU recursive depth for intra CUs. Default 1

--tune.label: Tune
--tune.description: Tune the encoder for a metric, grain retention, or latency constraint.

--vbv-bufsize.label: VBV Bufsize
--vbv-bufsize.description: Set size of the VBV buffer (kbit). Default 0

--vbv-end.label: VBV End
--vbv-end.description: Final VBV buffer emptiness (fraction of bufsize or in kbits). Default 0 (disabled)

--vbv-end-fr-adj.label: VBV End Fr Adj
--vbv-end-fr-adj.description: Frame from which qp has to be adjusted to achieve final decode buffer emptiness. Default 0

--vbv-init.label: VBV Init
--vbv-init.description: Initial VBV buffer occupancy (fraction of bufsize or in kbits). Default 0.90

--vbv-live-multi-pass.label: VBV Live Multi Pass
--vbv-live-multi-pass.description: Enable real-time VBV in rate control 2 pass. Default disabled

--video-signal-type-preset.label: Video Signal Type Preset

--videoformat.label: Videoformat
--videoformat.description: Specify video format from unknown, component, pal, ntsc, secam, mac. Default unknown

--vui-hrd-info.label: Vui Hrd Info
--vui-hrd-info.description: Emit VUI HRD information in the bitstream. Default enabled

--vui-timing-info.label: Vui Timing Info
--vui-timing-info.description: Emit VUI timing information in the bitstream. Default enabled

--weightb.label: Weightb
--weightb.description: Enable weighted prediction in B slices. Default disabled

--weightp.label: Weightp
--weightp.description: Enable weighted prediction in P slices. Default enabled

--wpp.label: WPP
--wpp.description: Enable wavefront parallel processing; the encoder enables it by default.

--y4m.label: Y4M input
--y4m.description: Read the input as a raw Y4M stream. The pipeline normally supplies this flag.

--zonefile.label: Zonefile
--zonefile.description: Zone file containing the zone boundaries and the parameters to be reconfigured.

-D.label: Output depth (short flag)
-D.description: Bits per sample in the output, 8, 10 or 12.
